name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Layered content sections — line or pill variants, optional icons and counts, horizontal or vertical, full keyboard navigation.

meta.whenToUse: Organize related content into peer sections the user switches between in place; a count after a trigger's label is an aria-hidden tabular number plus an sr-only suffix, so it reads as part of the tab's name. A line list scrolls sideways inside itself when the tabs outnumber the width; orientation="vertical" suits a stable column of settings sections. For tabs that are separate pages, draw a nav of links from tabsListVariants and tabsTriggerVariants with aria-current="page" (route tabs).
meta.whenNotToUse: Sequential multi-step flows (stepper), single-select form input (radio/select), sections that must be visible at once, or page-level navigation rendered as a tablist — route tabs are links, not tabs.
